top: a litre: the 2026-27 price oil companies pay for maize ethanol, fixed before the year begins.
a quintal: the notified price of FCI rice for distilleries from November 2026, below FCI's cost.
a tonne: the 2023 benchmark pellet price, converted at the specification's calorific range.

sections.h2: Each feedstock has its own ethanol price, fixed before the supply year starts

chart.title: Maize earns the most per litre; C-heavy molasses the least
chart.sub: Price paid for ethanol by feedstock, 2026-27, before GST and transport.

sections.means: A distiller can see in advance that maize earns Rs 68.86 a litre and C-heavy molasses Rs 57.97.
sections.todo: Publish a price per tonne for straw before each kharif season, as the ethanol programme does for each feedstock.

sections.h2: FCI sells rice to distilleries well below its own cost of about Rs 3,889

chart.title: Every notified rice price is below FCI's cost of about Rs 3,889
chart.sub: FCI rice sold to distilleries, June 2025 to June 2026, and from November 2026.
chart.source: FCI, as cited in the post.

sections.means: FCI sold 6.35 million tonnes of rice worth about Rs 14,597 crore to distilleries between June 2025 and June 2026.
sections.todo: Report FCI's cost beside each notified rice price, so the gap the government absorbs is visible every year.

sections.h2: Pellet prices clear estimated cost; grades, an index and storage are missing

chart.title: The 2023 pellet benchmark already exceeds estimated cost of making and moving
chart.sub: Rs a tonne, before GST and transport; pellet calorific range 2,800–4,000 kcal per kg.
chart.source: Power ministry benchmark, Nov 2023; CEEW estimate.
rows: CEEW cost to make and move, 50 km

sections.means: The benchmark works out to about Rs 6,356 to 9,080 a tonne across the specification's calorific range.
sections.todo: Direct effort at pellet grades, a price index and warehouse receipts, since the price already clears estimated cost.

sections.h2: Bamboo supply lagged: the plant was in start-up because raw material was short

chart.title: Four of 24 identified chipping units were supplying bamboo in February 2026
chart.sub: Decentralised chipping units serving the Numaligarh 2G ethanol plant, as of February 2026.
chart.source: ABEPL, as reported in the post.

sections.means: About 4,200 farmers had registered by February 2026, against a target of 30,000 within 300 km over three years.
sections.todo: Publish a price per tonne for bamboo, the one input the post says the plant still lacks, so suppliers can plan.
